// GREEN fixture — `no-permissive-authorizer-in-prod` (R2.6).
// The production shape: the explicit mounted-action allowlist policy (action seam) + the live
// check-backed repo authorizer (object seam). The permissive fixtures appear ONLY under test
// gates (`#[cfg(test)]` / `test-support`), definitions/doc mentions are not constructions, and
// the fail-closed Deny* fixtures are never flagged.

fn boot_edge() {
    let gateway = Gateway::builder(
        authn,
        human_login,
        Arc::new(AuthenticatedActionPolicy::mounted()),
    )
    .route(Method::Get, "/v1/whoami", "edge.whoami", Arc::new(WhoamiHandler))
    .build();
    serve(gateway);
}

fn rooted_backend(repo_authz: Arc<dyn RepoAuthorizer>) -> DurableGitBackend {
    DurableGitBackend {
        repo_authz,
        bootstrap: Arc::new(TupleRepoBootstrap::new(tuples)),
    }
}

/// A seam fixture that admits every principal/action — a TEST DOUBLE only. A doc mention of
/// `Arc::new(AllowAll)` is not a construction.
#[cfg(any(test, feature = "test-support"))]
pub struct AllowAll;

#[cfg(any(test, feature = "test-support"))]
impl Authorizer for AllowAll {
    fn authorize(&self, _principal: &Principal, _action: &str) -> bool {
        true
    }
}

fn deny_fixtures() {
    let deny_actions = Arc::new(DenyAll);
    let deny_repos = Arc::new(DenyAllRepos);
    consume(deny_actions, deny_repos);
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    fn harness() {
        let gw = Gateway::builder(authn_empty(), human_login(), Arc::new(AllowAll)).build();
        let be = backend().with_repo_authorizer(Arc::new(AllowAllRepos));
        drive(gw, be);
    }
}
